name: AutomationDirect CFS-AUX switch auxiliary contact
aliases: AutomationDirect CFS-AUX switch auxiliary contact GA
summary: CFS-AUX switch auxiliary contact arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: CFS-AUX is the drawing identifier for switch auxiliary contact in AutomationDirect's Gladiator CFS Series Disconnects collection. A switch auxiliary contact provides a selected control-circuit interface associated with the switch position or operation. It is different from the main power contacts and from the switch handle or operating shaft.

For example, in a machine control panel reporting the selected disconnect-switch state, use the CFS-AUX reference to coordinate switch attachment, auxiliary terminals and control-wiring access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Power Products/Gladiator CFS Series Disconnects/CFS-AUX.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep switch attachment, auxiliary terminals and control-wiring access visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named CFS-AUX drawing and its switch auxiliary contact role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
